about: Start and end anchors of each article's text in four 1947 draft texts, read by hand from the cleaned OCR (pipeline/early_draft_texts.py --show) and checked against the page images by a second reader (2026-09-23). also_final: other final articles the text belongs in the history of (a draft that was later split). Also a few articles of the other stages' texts whose headings the automatic run lost or whose cut ran on into the next article (set by hand, 2026-09-23): these replace the automatic cut. And the Commission's draft Covenants 1948-53 (E/800 annex B, E/1371, E/1681 annex I, E/1992, E/2256, E/2447): each article listed by one reader, anchored and mapped (instrument, final) by another, checked by a third against the scans, the final texts and E/2573 (2026-09-23). E/1681 annex I (the 1950 draft, 45 articles) was added the same way on 2026-09-25: one reader per half, a second reader checking the cuts against the scans. The United Kingdom's draft bill (E/CN.4/21, annex B, stage uk_draft_1947) and the Drafting Committee's articles for a convention (annex G, stage e_cn4_21_g), June 1947: anchored by one reader and checked by a second against the page text, each with its final article (2026-09-28). The Third Committee's text (A/777, 7 December 1948, stage a777), numbered before the plenary deleted its article 3: anchored by one reader and checked by a second, each with its final article (2026-09-28). The Third Committee's texts as adopted in its reports' annexes: A/4625 (articles 15-18, 1960, stage a4625) and A/5000 (articles 19-25, 1961, stage a5000), anchored from the printed text and checked with cut() (2026-09-28).
